name: King's Town Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: King's Town Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the residential and building development in Taiwan. The company also develops, leases, and sells specific professional zones. In addition, it engages in the hotel and restaurant businesses; and district expropriation and urban land rezoning agency business. The company was formerly known as Wei Cheng Construction Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
